title: Pricing a Change of Model Recorded on an Equipment Rental and Demo Agreement
content:
## The quantity to be arrived at

The fee for a change of model or size recorded on an agreement is worked out from the package's change fee, being the figure held against the package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line the agreement is written on.

**The window.** The window between the agreement being taken and the change being asked for is the calendar days from the date the reservation was recorded to the date the change was raised.

**The window share.** The whole of the package's change fee stands, whatever that window is: 100 per cent of it.

**Instruction.** Nothing is taken off for the collective's own instruction having called for the change.

**What is at stake in the kit.** The fee carries no uplift for what the collective has at stake in the kit.

**How the three meet one another.** The package's change fee is first taken at the window share, the figure that step leaves is then taken at the instruction share, and the figure that step leaves is then raised by the uplift, so each of the three acts on what the step before it left and not on the package's change fee itself.

**Precision.** The fee is worked out once and rounded half up to two decimal places.

A rider who has used the package's allowance of changes is offered a new agreement at the day rate rather than a further change, and no fee under this rule arises for them.

## The working on a hypothetical change

Take an agreement on a package whose change fee is 12.00 USD, taken on the 2nd of January, on which a change of model was raised on the 9th.

| Step | Working | Figure left after the step |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the window | the 2nd to the 9th of January | 7 days |
| the window share | 100 per cent of the package's change fee of 12.00 USD | 12.00 USD |
| the instruction share | nothing taken off the 12.00 USD that step left | 12.00 USD |
| the uplift | no uplift on the 12.00 USD that step left | 12.00 USD |
| the fee | worked out once and rounded half up to two decimal places | 12.00 USD |

The same working on a package whose change fee is 45.00 USD gives a fee of 45.00 USD, and on a package whose change fee is nil gives a fee of 0.00 USD.

## Points of judgement

**One chain, three steps.** The window share is taken on the package's change fee, the instruction share on the figure the window step left, and the uplift on the figure the instruction step left. No step is measured against the package's change fee afresh once the chain has begun.

**One rounding.** The fee is worked out once and rounded half up to two decimal places at that point, and not step by step.

**A rider who has used the allowance.** No fee arises under this rule for such a rider; what is offered is a new agreement at the day rate.
